note: Column-to-specimen mapping is the page reader's reading of Table 3 (ten data columns; Sex and Type status rows rendered with six entries). Text-table check: Description of holotype prints 'ED (eye diameter) 9.7 mm' and 'tympanum slightly visible (TYD 4.1 mm)', matching the holotype column. Female columns (IEBR A.5000, A.5037, A.5038) are not filed because their alignment under the six-entry Sex row is less certain; the paper prints no tympanum or eye value for them outside Table 3. Amphibian Species of the World lists Quasipaa taoi Pham, Hoang, Phan, Nguyen and Ziegler, 2022 (no synonymy; the page does not state the family, Dicroglossidae is the paper title's). No Class, Order or Family headings printed. Licence sentence on the copy read (opening printed): 'distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0)', with unrestricted use credited to author and source. Not on main by species or DOI. Reached with the WebSearch 'pensoft article download csv Quasipaa Ngoc Linh Holotype Paratype SVL HL TD ED measurements'.

method: linear measurement of preserved type specimens; Materials and methods prints 'Measurements were taken with digital calipers to the nearest 0.1 mm.' and defines 'TD (tympanum diameter) tympanum diameter;'; units from the Table 3 caption 'Measurements (in mm) and proportions of the type series of Quasipaa boulengeri and Quasipaa taoi sp. nov.'
conditions: Adult male paratype IEBR A.4998 of Quasipaa taoi sp. nov. (Type status row: P). Type material as printed: holotype IEBR A.4997 (adult male); paratypes IEBR A.4998 and A.4999 (adult males) and IEBR A.5000, A.5037, A.5038 (adult females), all with the holotype's collection data (Ngoc Linh Natural Reserve, Kon Tum Province, Vietnam). Table 3 layout as read: Specimen ID row 'IEBR A.4997 | IEBR A.4999 | IEBR A.4998 | Min-Max (n = 3) | Mean±SD (n = 3) | IEBR A.5000 | IEBR A.5038 | IEBR A.5037 | Min-Max | Mean±SD'; the quoted row therefore gives the three males, their range and mean, then the three females, their range and mean. Preserved specimens; anatomy only, hearing not tested.
